_comment: Single source of truth. scripts/build_catalog.py generates catalog.md from this; scripts/install.sh installs from it. install: 'skills' = npx skills add <repo> --skill <name>; others are special cases.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.desc: A design-quality bar and anti-slop ruleset with commands to shape, critique, audit, polish, harden and animate any frontend interface.
skills.use: Always; it is the quality bar. Run it to shape, critique, audit or polish any interface.

skills.name: apple-design
skills.desc: Apple-style fluid, physical interface design from WWDC talks: springs, gestures, materials, typography, restraint.
skills.use: Gestures, springs, sheets, translucent materials, typography; anything that should feel physical and Apple-like.

skills.name: emil-design-eng
skills.desc: Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design and the invisible details that make software feel great.
skills.use: Polishing details: hover/press states, easing, component feel, the small things that separate good from great.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.desc: Searchable design intelligence: 79 styles, 192 product palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX rules, 22 stacks, for web, mobile and desktop.
skills.use: No design system yet. Search it for a palette, font pairing, style and UX rules matched to the product type.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.desc: Anthropic's guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design instead of templated defaults.
skills.use: Anything that looks like a default template; sets a distinctive aesthetic direction first.

skills.name: design-system
skills.desc: Three-layer design tokens (primitive, semantic, component), CSS variables, scales and component specs.
skills.use: Before building many screens: define tokens (color, type, spacing, radius, motion) once.

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.desc: Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines checklist for auditing accessibility, forms, focus, motion and UX in UI code.
skills.use: Reviewing finished UI for accessibility, forms, focus, motion and content rules.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.desc: Taste Skill v2: anti-slop art direction for websites with a real-browser inspector and a look-and-fix loop.
skills.use: Public-facing pages that look generic or AI-made; use its look-and-fix screenshot loop.

skills.name: high-end-visual-design
skills.desc: Agency-grade premium look: exact fonts, spacing, shadows, cards and animation that feel expensive.
skills.use: The brief says premium, luxury, agency-grade or expensive.

skills.name: minimalist-ui
skills.desc: Clean, editorial, quiet interfaces with restrained color and generous whitespace.
skills.use: The brief says clean, editorial, calm, quiet or Notion/Linear-like.

skills.name: industrial-brutalist-ui
skills.desc: Raw, technical, brutalist interfaces with hard edges and bold typography.
skills.use: The brief says raw, technical, brutalist or bold-typography.

skills.name: redesign-existing-projects
skills.desc: Audits an existing site, finds generic AI patterns and upgrades it to premium without breaking functionality.
skills.use: An existing site or app needs an upgrade without breaking it.

skills.name: stitch-design-taste
skills.desc: Generates agent-readable DESIGN.md design-system files (Google Stitch style) with strict anti-generic rules.
skills.use: You want a DESIGN.md that locks the system for later builds.

skills.name: gpt-taste
skills.desc: Editorial layouts with GSAP motion, bento grids and strict page structure for high-impact marketing pages.
skills.use: Marketing pages that need editorial layout, bento grids and GSAP motion.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.desc: Ten preset color and font themes, or a generated one, to style pages, slides and docs consistently.
skills.use: Quick consistent color and font themes for pages, slides or docs.

skills.name: brandkit
skills.desc: Creates brand-guidelines boards, logo systems and identity decks as images.
skills.use: Brand-guidelines boards, logo systems and identity decks as images.

skills.name: design
skills.desc: Brand identity, logos, banners, icons, social images and slide decks in one toolkit.
skills.use: Logos, banners, icons, social images, slides and brand identity.

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.desc: Original static visual art, posters and hero graphics as PNG or PDF.
skills.use: A one-off poster, hero graphic or static artwork.

skills.name: hallmark
skills.desc: Anti-AI-slop design skill for new pages, audits, redesigns, and extracting a design system from a URL or screenshot.
skills.use: Greenfield pages, audits and redesigns; also extracts a design system from a URL or screenshot you admire.

skills.name: design-md
skills.desc: Analyzes a design and writes a DESIGN.md design-system file agents can build against.
skills.use: Capture an existing design into a DESIGN.md so every later build matches it.

skills.name: taste-design
skills.desc: Stitch's taste skill: premium, anti-generic DESIGN.md rules for type, color, layout and micro-motion.
skills.use: Writing a strict premium DESIGN.md (type, color, layout, micro-motion) from scratch.

skills.name: awwwards
skills.desc: Builds award-caliber sites from a one-line prompt: concept, art direction, typography, motion, WebGL, SEO, accessibility, browser QA.
skills.use: You want a portfolio, studio or launch site that should look award-winning and immersive.

skills.name: jury
skills.desc: Scores a live or local site like an Awwwards jury: screenshots, LCP/CLS/FPS, axe, keyboard focus, SEO, then a ranked fix list.
skills.use: You want a site scored and critiqued (live URL or local build) with a ranked fix list. Review only, no edits.

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.desc: Generates or reads a design image first, analyzes it deeply, then builds the page to match it closely.
skills.use: The user supplied a screenshot or mockup, or wants a design image made first and then built.

skills.name: imagegen-frontend-web
skills.desc: Creates premium section-by-section website design reference images before coding.
skills.use: Planning a landing page: generate section-by-section design references before any code.

skills.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
skills.desc: Creates app-native screen concepts and flows for iOS, Android and cross-platform apps.
skills.use: Planning an app: generate screen concepts and flows before any code.

skills.name: 21st-ui-explore
skills.desc: Explores several meaningfully different UI directions grounded in your design system and the 21st.dev catalog.
skills.use: Direction is undecided; compare 2 to 3 distinct looks.

skills.name: 21st-ui-build
skills.desc: Builds production UI from your project's components plus grounded 21st.dev inspiration.
skills.use: Implementing a page or section with the project's real components plus catalog inspiration.

skills.name: 21st-ui-review
skills.desc: Audits UI for design-system fit, accessibility, responsiveness and interaction quality, and fixes safe defects.
skills.use: Auditing finished UI for accessibility, responsiveness and consistency; fixes safe issues.

skills.name: 21st-cli-use
skills.desc: Searches and installs React/shadcn components, themes and templates from the 21st.dev catalog.
skills.use: Before hand-writing a component: search the 21st.dev catalog and pull code.

skills.name: ui-styling
skills.desc: shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind patterns for accessible components, dark mode and themes.
skills.use: Tailwind plus shadcn/ui implementation, dark mode and theming.

skills.name: pick-ui-library
skills.desc: Picks the right library for a frontend need (charts, OTP, command menus, drag and drop) from a curated list.
skills.use: You need charts, OTP inputs, command menus, drag and drop or virtualization and want the right library.

skills.name: prototype
skills.desc: Builds several different versions of a UI piece behind a live picker so you can flip through and promote one.
skills.use: You want several versions of one UI piece behind a live switcher to choose from.

skills.name: shadcn-ui
skills.desc: Finds, installs and customizes shadcn/ui components with best practices.
skills.use: Adding or customizing shadcn/ui components in a project.

skills.name: diagram-design
skills.desc: Branded diagrams and charts as HTML/SVG/PNG: architecture, flow, sequence, timelines, Sankey, heatmaps and 50+ more types.
skills.use: You need a diagram or chart: architecture, flow, timeline, Sankey, heatmap and so on.

skills.name: hairline-create
skills.desc: Draws a new isometric line-art figure that reacts to the pointer, as one self-contained HTML file.
skills.use: You want a playful isometric line-art figure that follows the cursor.

skills.name: hairline-adopt
skills.desc: Turns an existing SVG (icon, logo, illustration) into an interactive isometric Hairline figure.
skills.use: You have an SVG logo or icon you want turned into that interactive figure.

skills.name: animate
skills.desc: Builds an animation by deciding in order: whether to animate, purpose, properties, easing and fallback.
skills.use: Adding or fixing one web animation (decides whether, why, which properties, easing).

skills.name: improve-animations
skills.desc: Audits a codebase's motion and produces a prioritized plan to improve it.
skills.use: Audit a whole codebase's motion and get a prioritized plan.

skills.name: review-animations
skills.desc: Reviews animation code against a high craft bar and flags what falls short.
skills.use: Critique motion code in a diff or file.

skills.name: find-animation-opportunities
skills.desc: Finds places that should animate but don't, and rejects motion that shouldn't exist.
skills.use: Find places that should animate and do not.

skills.name: animation-performance
skills.desc: Keeps web animation inside the frame budget with composite-only properties and off-main-thread motion.
skills.use: Animation is janky or drops frames.

skills.name: animation-vocabulary
skills.desc: Turns a vague description of an effect into its exact name and technique.
skills.use: You can describe an effect but not name it.

skills.name: vercel-react-view-transitions
skills.desc: Page and shared-element transitions with React's View Transition API.
skills.use: Page or shared-element transitions in React or Next.js.

skills.name: motionmaxxing
skills.desc: Directs senior-level motion-graphics films (launches, promos, kinetic type) with brand capture, GSAP runtime and scripted quality gates.
skills.use: A launch video, product promo, feature reveal, kinetic-type piece or social ad; also critiquing or fixing one.

skills.name: hyperframes
skills.desc: Entry point for HyperFrames: any video, animation or motion graphic written as HTML and rendered to MP4.
skills.use: Start here for any video, motion graphic, captioned clip or HTML-to-MP4 request; it routes to the others.

skills.name: hyperframes-core
skills.desc: The HyperFrames composition contract: structure, timing attributes, tracks and deterministic rendering.
skills.use: Writing or fixing a HyperFrames composition's HTML and timing.

skills.name: hyperframes-animation
skills.desc: Motion rules, scene blueprints, transitions and runtime adapters (GSAP, Lottie, Three.js and more) for video.
skills.use: Choosing animation rules, transitions and runtimes inside a video.

skills.name: hyperframes-creative
skills.desc: Creative direction for video: palettes, typography, narration, beat planning and brand decisions.
skills.use: Palette, type, narration and beat planning for a video.

skills.name: hyperframes-keyframes
skills.desc: Camera moves, punch-ins, Ken Burns, SVG morph and 3D keyframes that stay seek-safe.
skills.use: Zooms, camera moves, Ken Burns, SVG morphs in a video.

skills.name: hyperframes-cli
skills.desc: The HyperFrames command line: init, lint, preview, render, doctor and cloud rendering.
skills.use: Running, previewing, linting or rendering a HyperFrames project; diagnosing render errors.

skills.name: motion-graphics
skills.desc: Short design-led motion graphics: kinetic type, stat count-ups, logo stings, lower thirds, animated maps and UI animation.
skills.use: Under 30 seconds: kinetic type, stat count-ups, logo stings, lower thirds, animated maps.

skills.name: product-launch-video
skills.desc: Turns a product URL, script or brief into a launch or promo video.
skills.use: You have a product URL, script or brief and want a promo video.

skills.name: slideshow
skills.desc: Builds an interactive HTML slide deck with fragments, branching and a presenter mode.
skills.use: An interactive HTML deck or pitch with presenter mode.

skills.name: animate-studio
skills.desc: Turns a style reference and a rough idea into a finished animated video where every frame is drawn in code (by @guipaulinooo). Not redistributed: see README.
skills.use: An explainer or animated story from a style reference where every frame is drawn in code.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.desc: Vercel Engineering's React and Next.js performance rules.
skills.use: Writing or reviewing React/Next.js code for performance.

skills.name: vercel-composition-patterns
skills.desc: Scalable React composition: compound components, render props, flexible component APIs.
skills.use: Components with too many boolean props or a reusable component API to design.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.desc: Production-quality, accessible, responsive UI: layout, state, WCAG and component structure.
skills.use: Building production components: layout, state, WCAG, responsive structure.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.desc: Measures and fixes performance and Core Web Vitals regressions.
skills.use: Core Web Vitals, slow loads or regressions.

skills.name: mobile-native
skills.desc: The small CSS and meta-tag fixes that make a web app feel installed on a phone.
skills.use: A web app or PWA used on phones that feels like a website.

skills.name: break-ui
skills.desc: Stress-tests UI with worst-case data: long names, empty states, huge counts, missing fields.
skills.use: Before shipping: stress-test with long names, empty and huge data.

skills.name: vercel-react-native-skills
skills.desc: React Native and Expo performance and best practices: lists, animation, native modules.
skills.use: React Native / Expo performance, lists, native modules.

skills.name: expo-design-system
skills.desc: Design tokens, variant conventions and anti-slop rules for a consistent Expo app.
skills.use: Setting up tokens and variants in an Expo app or fixing generic-looking screens.

skills.name: expo-native-ui
skills.desc: Native-feeling Expo screens: Apple HIG, semantic colors, SF Symbols, native controls.
skills.use: Making Expo screens feel native (HIG, SF Symbols, native controls).

skills.name: expo-ui
skills.desc: Real SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose components from @expo/ui: sheets, pickers, menus, forms.
skills.use: Sheets, pickers, menus and forms using real SwiftUI / Jetpack Compose.

skills.name: expo-router
skills.desc: File-based routing, native tabs, stacks, modals and headers in Expo Router.
skills.use: Navigation, tabs, modals and headers in Expo.

skills.name: expo-animation
skills.desc: Reanimated, gestures, sheets, transitions and haptics for Expo, decided in the right order.
skills.use: Gestures, sheets, transitions and haptics in Expo.

skills.name: swiftui-ui-patterns
skills.desc: SwiftUI patterns for navigation, tabs, stacks, grids and state.
skills.use: Building SwiftUI screens, tabs and navigation.

skills.name: swiftui-liquid-glass
skills.desc: Adopt and review the iOS 26 Liquid Glass API correctly.
skills.use: Adopting the iOS 26 Liquid Glass look.

skills.name: swiftui-view-refactor
skills.desc: Cleans up SwiftUI views: small subviews, stable trees, correct Observation use.
skills.use: Cleaning up large SwiftUI views.

skills.name: swiftui-performance-audit
skills.desc: Diagnoses slow rendering, janky scrolling and excess view updates in SwiftUI.
skills.use: Janky scrolling or heavy view updates in SwiftUI.

skills.name: write-swift
skills.desc: Modern Swift 6: value types, concurrency and data-race safety.
skills.use: Writing or migrating modern Swift 6 code.

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.desc: Drives a real browser from the terminal to screenshot, click and test pages at any viewport.
skills.use: Screenshots at 375/768/1280 and click-through checks of a running app.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.desc: Inspects the DOM, console, network and performance in a real browser through Chrome DevTools.
skills.use: Inspecting DOM, console, network and performance in a real browser.

skills.name: awesome-design-md
skills.desc: 84 ready-made DESIGN.md files extracted from real brands (Stripe, Linear, Airbnb and more) to copy as a design system.
skills.use: The user names a brand look; copy its DESIGN.md as the system.

skills.name: awesome-claude-design
skills.desc: Index of 68 ready-made DESIGN.md design systems (brands) to hand to Claude as a design brief.
skills.use: Same idea: browse 68 more brand DESIGN.md files and follow the links.
